Creator Discusses Sex Education Through Comedy in New Series

Filmmaker Mallik Ram has discussed his approach to presenting sex education in his new Netflix Telugu original, 'Super Subbu'. He emphasized the use of comedy as a method to address the sensitive topic effectively. The series aims to make discussions around sex education more accessible and less intimidating for audiences.
